reasoning_records.title: Position sizing under uncertain demand
claims: When demand visibility is incomplete, position size should reflect uncertainty rather than conviction alone.
observations: The speaker-style example distinguishes between a promising setup and a confirmed trend.
reasoning_steps: Separate long-term thesis from short-term entry risk.
Use smaller exposure until confirming data appears.
assumptions: The investor cannot verify current demand conditions.
conditions: Increase confidence only after new evidence confirms demand or margin improvement.
risks: Entering too aggressively may create avoidable drawdown if the thesis is early.
exceptions: A small exploratory position may still be acceptable when the downside is explicitly budgeted.
uncertainty: Current demand and market sentiment remain unresolved.
decisions_or_preferences: Prefer staged exposure over all-in positioning.
actions_or_avoided_actions: Avoid treating a plausible narrative as confirmed evidence.
view_change_conditions: Change the view if confirming data appears or the original risk budget is breached.
speaker_behavior: Uses conditional reasoning and emphasizes risk budget before conviction.
